hints.title: Evaluate Base and Doubled Array
hints.text: The best subarray either lies wholly within a single repetition or spans across the boundary of adjacent repetitions.

hints.title: Inspect Array Total Sum
hints.text: If the total sum across one repetition is strictly positive, every additional middle repetition contributes its entire sum.

hints.title: Combine Kadane with Repetition Multipliers
hints.text: For k greater than one, take the max sum on two copies plus (k - 2) times positive total sum, all under modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating k concatenations directly requires O(k * N) time and memory, which exceeds limits for k up to 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Running maximum subarray once or twice requires linear time and constant auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle empty subarray returning zero and avoid negative results under modulo.
complexity.notes: All calculations must be performed modulo 10^9 + 7.
